level_title: Boss Trial: Lambda-Prime, The Relic Sovereign

questions.title: Phase 1: Declaring the Relic Breaker (def)
questions.prompt: Lambda-Prime projects an Arcane Vault Aegis! Complete the Python keyword to define a reusable spell function named 'shatter_aegis'.
questions.hint: Master PyWizard says: Every Python function declaration begins with the 3-letter keyword 'def'!
questions.explanation: Direct hit! In Python, 'def function_name():' defines a reusable block of code that executes whenever called.

questions.title: Phase 2: Passing Arcane Arguments (Parameters)
questions.prompt: Lambda-Prime shifts his Relic Core frequency! If we call 'cast_lance("amethyst", 3)', what will 'power' be set to inside the function?
questions.hint: Master PyWizard says: Positional arguments match parameters in order from left to right: element = "amethyst", power = 3.
questions.explanation: Bullseye! Positional argument '3' is bound to the second parameter 'power', dealing 3 * 25 = 75 arcane damage!

questions.title: Phase 3: Capturing the Relic Output (return)
questions.prompt: Compute the exact resonance needed to crack Lambda-Prime's armor! Fill in the keyword that sends the calculated value back to the caller.
questions.hint: Master PyWizard says: Without 'return', a function gives back 'None'. Use 'return' to send a result back!
questions.explanation: Armor cracked! The 'return' statement outputs 80 so 'total_dmg' stores the computed result instead of None.

questions.title: Phase 4: Default Parameter Overdrive
questions.prompt: Lambda-Prime summons a Modular Suppression Field! What value does 'amplify_spell(10)' return when the second argument is omitted?
questions.hint: Master PyWizard says: 'boost=3' in the function header defines a default parameter value used whenever only 1 argument is passed!
questions.explanation: Suppression Field broken! Since 'boost' has a default value of 3, calling 'amplify_spell(10)' evaluates '10 * 3' and returns 30.

questions.title: Final Phase: The Modular Sovereign Finisher!
questions.prompt: Lambda-Prime is down to his final 100 HP! Arrange the Python blocks in the exact order to define 'relic_finisher(charge)', return the amplified strike, and invoke it!
questions.code_snippet: # Construct the Function Definition, Return Statement, and Call
questions.hint: Master PyWizard says: First define the function header ('def ...:'), then indent the 'return' body, and finally call the function outside!
questions.explanation: VICTORY! You mastered 'def', parameters, and 'return' to vanquish Lambda-Prime, The Modular Relic Sovereign!
